answer.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ and activation is down 6% QoQ. Memory_86 and memory_31 both demonstrated that reducing friction in signup and onboarding drives measurable lift in early adoption and completion rates. These memories are directly applicable to the current problem and warrant verification before execution. Simplify_onboarding is preferable to promotional_pricing (memory_73 showed deep discounts harm renewal churn) and to referral_incentive (memory_57 works well for established customers, not acquisition). Enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) targets a different segment. Activation_messaging (memory_91) is complementary but onboarding simplification addresses the root friction. A standard_experiment allows us to validate the effect size on the current cohort without overcommitting. This preserves our ability to pivot if the competitive pressure requires a different lever later.
